Auth.//AllowedOrigins: Both spellings of the loopback host: an Origin header is matched as an exact string, so a developer who opens 127.0.0.1 is a different origin from one who opens localhost.
Auth.//RefreshCookieSameSiteStrict: Kept strict locally too — the SPA proxies /api through Vite, so it is same-site in development as well.
